newsitem.title: USA: Nabors says Samson deal to close in April.
newsitem.headline: Nabors says Samson deal to close in April.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc said Monday its $85 million cash deal to acquire two companies from a subsidiary of Samson Investment Co was expected to close in April, not in May as it earlier reported.

To be acquired under a definitive agreement are Samson Rig Co and Rig Properties Inc, whose assets include 25 rigs many of which are capable of drilling greater than 15,000 feet, component equipment and a few parcels of real estate and associate buildings and yard facilities.

Gene Isenberg, chairman and chief executive officer of Nabors, said the company expects to start utilizing some of the rigs shortly and have most, if not all of them, generating revenues within the next two years.
